rules.statement: A mortgagor can redeem the mortgage bond at any time during the period for which interest has been paid in advance, provided they do not waive their right to claim overpaid interest.
rules.supporting_quote: "Payment of interest in advance on a mortgage bond does not fetter the mortgagor's right of redemption during the period for which the payment in advance is made. Where a mortgagor who has paid interest in advance exercises his right of redemption during the period for which the payment in advance is made and, while paying the capital in full, makes it clear that he does not waive his right to claim the interest overpaid. Held, that he is entitled by means of the condictio sine causa to recover such interest."
